settings.legal.privacy.servers.description: Settings, account, onboarding or privacy UI: settings.legal.privacy.servers

settings.legal.privacy.servers_body.value: JellyRust is an independent client for Jellyfin. It has no account, online service or reporting of its own and sends nothing anywhere except to your Jellyfin server: signing in, browsing and playing media, watch progress and every other server feature go directly to the Jellyfin server whose address you enter, and are handled by that server and whoever operates it. JellyRust’s developer does not receive any of it.
settings.legal.privacy.servers_body.description: Settings, account, onboarding or privacy UI: settings.legal.privacy.servers_body

settings.legal.privacy.local.description: Settings, account, onboarding or privacy UI: settings.legal.privacy.local

settings.legal.privacy.local_body.value: JellyRust stores the address, name, identifier and version of the Jellyfin server you signed in to, and for each person signed in on this television (up to twelve, listed on the Who's watching? screen) their user name and user identifier there, the access token that server issued to this television and the device identifier it was issued under. It never stores your password. It also keeps downloaded artwork (posters, backdrops and cast images, cached as bounded files for reuse across restarts), each person's Home library choices and recent searches, kept apart from everyone else's, your playback quality, Direct Play and app language preferences, and local technical logs: a small rotating event log and a bounded storage status snapshot. It keeps no bookmark of its own for where you stopped watching: playback position is held by your Jellyfin server. Delete all local data in Settings signs out and removes JellyRust data from this television.
settings.legal.privacy.local_body.description: Settings, account, onboarding or privacy UI: settings.legal.privacy.local_body

settings.legal.privacy.retention.description: Settings, account, onboarding or privacy UI: settings.legal.privacy.retention

settings.legal.privacy.retention_body.value: Different things here have different lifetimes, so this is stated for each. Signing out removes that one person's Jellyfin sign-in from this television (their user name and identifier there, and the access token) and asks the server to revoke the token; everyone else signed in stays. When the last person signs out, the address, name and identifier of the server signed in to last are kept, with no user or token, so the sign-in screen can offer it under Recent; signing in to another server replaces it. Each person's library choices, searches and subtitle adjustments are kept apart from everyone else's. Signing out does not currently remove anything else JellyRust keeps, including that server and the signed-out person's library choices and searches: use Delete all local data to remove those. The event log rotates continuously and the storage snapshot is replaced when its bounded status changes. Delete all local data removes all of it. The app language preference belongs to this television and is kept when you sign out; Delete all local data resets it.
settings.legal.privacy.retention_body.description: Settings, account, onboarding or privacy UI: settings.legal.privacy.retention_body

settings.legal.privacy.choices.value: YOUR CHOICES AND HOW TO ASK
settings.legal.privacy.choices.description: Settings, account, onboarding or privacy UI: settings.legal.privacy.choices

settings.legal.privacy.choices_body.value: There is no reporting to turn on or off: JellyRust sends nothing anywhere except to your Jellyfin server. Delete all local data in Settings removes everything JellyRust stored on this television. What your Jellyfin server keeps, such as watch progress and favourites, is managed on that server.
settings.legal.privacy.choices_body.description: Settings, account, onboarding or privacy UI: settings.legal.privacy.choices_body

settings.legal.privacy.processing.description: Settings, account, onboarding or privacy UI: settings.legal.privacy.processing

settings.legal.privacy.processing_body.value: Neither JellyRust’s developer nor any third party processes anything JellyRust does. A Jellyfin server you connect to may be located anywhere and is operated by whoever runs it, not by JellyRust’s developer.
settings.legal.privacy.processing_body.description: Settings, account, onboarding or privacy UI: settings.legal.privacy.processing_body

settings.legal.privacy.uninstall.description: Settings, account, onboarding or privacy UI: settings.legal.privacy.uninstall

settings.legal.privacy.uninstall_body.value: Removing JellyRust removes the application, but webOS gives an application no way to run code as it is removed, so anything kept outside the application’s own directory can survive. Your sign-in is deliberately kept there so that reinstalling does not sign you out. Your app language preference is also kept there. Use Delete all local data BEFORE uninstalling if you want nothing of JellyRust left on this television.
settings.legal.privacy.uninstall_body.description: Settings, account, onboarding or privacy UI: settings.legal.privacy.uninstall_body

settings.playback.force_body.value:
Bypasses playback compatibility checks and always uses original quality. Playback may have no sound, display incorrectly, freeze, or crash the app. JellyRust will not automatically switch to compatible playback and may not recover gracefully.

Enable this only if you understand these risks and know how to restart the app and return Direct Play to Auto.

settings.playback.direct_play.copy.value: Auto plays the original file when this television can; otherwise your Jellyfin server converts it. Disabled always converts. Force skips every check: for troubleshooting only.
settings.playback.direct_play.copy.description: Explanation under the title of the Direct Play picker. Names its three modes in order: Auto, Disabled and Force (the picker's third option, 'Force Direct Play (advanced)'). While Force is on the Force note replaces it.

Picture subtitles (PGS, VobSub) and styled (ASS/SSA) subtitles carry their own geometry, so the setting does not reach them; the same control is the Size row under Style on the Subtitles tab of the player's track menu.

settings.playback.subtitle_position.copy.value: How high subtitles sit on the picture. Picture and styled subtitles keep their own position. Also under Style in the player's Subtitles menu.

settings.playback.next_episode.copy.value: Up Next countdown shows a Next episode button when the credits start. After credits lets them play, then starts the next episode. Off closes the player instead.
settings.playback.next_episode.copy.description: Explanation under the title of the Next episode picker. It names the three options by their picker labels (Up Next countdown, After credits, Off); keep those words identical to settings.playback.next_episode.countdown, .after_credits and .off. Only credits that run to the end of the item trigger the button.

settings.playback.skip_interval.copy.description: Explanation under the title of the Skip interval picker. One value for both directions; it also sets the hop in the trailer transport.

settings.legal.privacy.plaintext_body.description: In-app privacy disclosure, aligned with PRIVACY.md.
settings.legal.privacy.plaintext_body.value: When you enter an address without http:// or https://, JellyRust tries plain http first for an address on your home network and https first for a domain name, and falls back to the other if the first does not answer. Over http, your password, access token and everything JellyRust exchanges with the server travel over the network without encryption. Enter the full https:// address for a server you reach over the internet. JellyRust sends nothing that signs you in over plain http until you allow it for that server. It asks once; the answer covers that server at that address only. Each time it connects, it first checks that the same server answers there. The answers are kept when you sign out; Settings › Unencrypted connections turns each one off, and Delete all local data removes them.
